title: Cutting The Cords - Stress Release Meditation
description:
Listen for FREE – download for a small fee.

I wrote this for me.  It’s true.  The events of the world, between the 2020 Pandemic and all of the tragedy going on in the world, I’m struggling.  I’ve heard from many of you who are describing a similar emotional state, so I wanted to share this meditation with you.

This is not hypnosis;  it’s a guided meditation.

What’s the difference?  I’m only guiding you into a light state of relaxation, and I’m allowing you to do the work within your mind, where I am merely a guide.

Cutting the cords is a very popular and effective meditation.  The premise is that you will cut the emotional cord that bind the cause of your stress, grief, sadness, emotional pain etc, with you.  To the conscious mind, it may see like a silly visualization, but when you truly understand how the subconscious mind works, then you’ll understnad it’s power.

One of the way that the subconscious mind communicates, is through visualizations (just like when you dream).  When you map out a set of instructions through  your imagination, you’re giving a direct blueprint on what you would like to achieve.

When you cut the cords, you’re telling your subconscious mind that you want to let go of the hold that something or someone has over you.

I’ve given this meditation to many people, including myself, and I’ve always heard positive feedback.

RECOMMENDATIONS:

I would recommend using this meditation for at least 21 consecutive days.  In my experience, your subconscious only reveals to you a little bit at a time, therefore, each session could bring about a new cord to be cut.
